Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.users

Class UsersRest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.BasicRestServlet
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.users.UsersRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class UsersRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
The Users page and its endpoints. The password is write-only: every read goes through UsersRest.UserView, which has no password, so it never leaves the server; an update with no password keeps the stored one.
Example:

// The wire shape of a create (JSON5): the password is accepted but never echoed. { username:'newbie', firstName:'New', lastName:'Bie', password:'s3cret' }

<@card type="datatables" id="users"> { dataMode:'server', dataUrl:'/console/users/query', columns:[{key:'username', label:'Username'}, ...] } </@card>
